description: Defines the WebrtcVideoPerfHistory class responsible for storing and retrieving WebRTC video performance statistics, interfacing with a database, and providing Mojo API implementations.

classes.name: WebrtcVideoPerfHistory
classes.description: Manages WebRTC video performance data, interfaces with a database, and provides Mojo API implementations for performance info retrieval and storage.

methods.name: BindReceiver
methods.description: Binds a Mojo receiver to this instance to handle multiple clients.

methods.name: GetPerfInfo
methods.description: Retrieves performance information based on features and frame rate.

methods.name: GetSaveCallback
methods.description: Provides a callback to save performance records.

methods.name: ClearHistory
methods.description: Clears all stored performance data from the database.

methods.name: GetWebrtcVideoStatsDB
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying WebrtcVideoStatsDB instance.
